criteria: IDE is a default center panel after Scene and Game
File/Panels item alignment, bottom Undo/Redo and distinct Create project button
Long AI labels fit and new branches close their siblings
Ambient light changes canonical RGB and marks the project title dirty
Project parent icon and scoped Backspace navigate to the parent folder
Duplicate C# names across folders retain inline editing until corrected
Empty folder context Delete completes without confirmation
Copy Path returns an absolute native export with the canonical source bytes
Folder hover highlights the actual tree destination and drop persists the move
Delayed rename responds to the filename only, never the icon
C# double-click opens IDE; Ctrl+S commits source and project; Panels restores a closed IDE
Escape, blank Project clicks and entity deletion clear selection; files/entities are exclusive
Rename refreshes file Inspector and context Open displays the renamed C# class in IDE
Nested context Create menus stay inside the viewport
2D ambient settings persist without adding incompatible HDR rendering
Debug checkbox is round and vertically aligned with Play
